title: Mr Leopold Bloom ate with relish the inner organs of beasts and fowls
html_source: As an introduction to Bloom, this serves as an arresting contrast to Stephen Daedalus the intellectual, hifalutin type, who lives in the world of the cerebral – Bloom loves to eat meat, and lives in the world of the real, of delicious food, not abstract theories.

anchor.text: Mr Leopold Bloom ate with relish the inner organs of beasts and fowls
